description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This leadership role involves overseeing all aspects of facility management, including resident care, regulatory compliance, financial performance, and staff development. The successful candidate will ensure the delivery of high-quality care in a supportive and efficient environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned administrator to make a significant impact within a reputable organization. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about long-term care and committed to fostering a positive culture for both residents and staff.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration or a related field
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing facility
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA)
Demonstrated leadership, financial management, and operational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time role offers a vital opportunity to contribute to the quality of patient care through comprehensive assessment and care planning.As an RN MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for completing and coordinating the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing individualized care plans, and ensuring compliance with all federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in accurately reflecting resident needs and ensuring appropriate reimbursement.This is a full-time position for a professional committed to excellence in long-term care. Join a team focused on providing high-quality services and making a positive impact on residents' lives.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and care planning processes
Familiarity with federal and state regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $65,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.
